title: Short the merge queue for conflicting PRs using a priority auction
today: Today you can't prevent merge conflicts that arise from simultaneous PRs targeting the same files.
with_this: With this, you can let PRs bid for file access, so only the highest-priority or lowest-risk change merges first.

title: Bundle legacy code into CDOs to isolate refactoring risk
today: Today you can't isolate the risk of a massive legacy refactor so that a failure doesn't tank the whole project
with_this: With this, you can refactor a dangerous legacy block without blocking the rest of the team, because the risk is contained in a separate 'tranche'

title: Predict the bid-ask spread for code review approval
today: Today you can't know how long a code review will take or how much negotiation it will require
with_this: With this, you can optimize your PR size to minimize the 'spread' between the ask for review and the bid of approval

title: Hedge refactoring time against team vacation calendar
today: Today you can't account for the risk that a refactor will be abandoned when key experts go on leave
with_this: With this, you can delay a critical refactor until after key personnel return, or accelerate it to finish before they leave, based on risk pricing

title: Hire evidence agents for each feature decision
today: Today you can't choose the right mix of tests, documentation, and reviewers for a feature because the gate treats all checks as equal.
with_this: With this, you can get a cost-aware gate that allocates effort to the agents most likely to catch the real risk, saving time and reducing false alarms.
